name: Meshy 3D Agent
summary: Generate 3D models, textures, images, rig characters, animate them, and prepare for 3D printing using the Meshy AI API. Handles API key detection, task creation, polling, downloading, and full 3D print pipeline with slicer integration. Use when the user asks to create 3D models, convert text/images to 3D, texture models, rig or animate characters, 3D print a model, or interact with the Meshy API.

name: Meshy 3D Generation
summary: Create or edit digital 3D assets with Meshy: models, textures, rigging, animation, and reference images. For physical printing, use meshy-3d-printing.

name: Meshy 3D Printing
summary: Generate or prepare models for physical 3D printing, including white or multicolor prints, Creative Lab products, sizing, and slicer handoff.

name: Meshy Openclaw
summary: Create 3D models, textures, reference images, rigging and animation with Meshy, and prepare models for physical 3D printing: white or multicolor prints, Creative Lab products, sizing and slicer handoff. Drives the Meshy CLI; signs in through the browser, no API key required.
